rows.commentary: 17.5: Abhisekh Tiwari delivers to Andre Russell, who works it out to deep mid-wicket for a single.
17.6: Abhisekh Tiwari claims the wicket of Lokesh Bam, caught by Lalit Rajbanshi after a brilliant fifty featuring three fours and three sixes.
18.1: Rahul Yadav bowls a wide to Andre Russell.
18.1: Rahul Yadav comes into the attack and watches Andre Russell push the ball away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
18.2: Rahul Yadav floats it up to Shubham Ranjane, who collects a single down towards long-on.
18.3: Rahul Yadav is greeted by Andre Russell tucking a single away into the backward square leg region.
18.4: No run for Shubham Ranjane off Rahul Yadav.
18.5: Rahul Yadav misses his length and Shubham Ranjane punishes him with a boundary racing to extra cover.
18.6: Rahul Yadav keeps it tidy as Shubham Ranjane knocks a single out to deep mid-wicket.
19.1: Abhisekh Tiwari returns and concedes a single to long-on off the bat of Shubham Ranjane.
19.2: No-ball from Abhisekh Tiwari to Andre Russell.
19.2: Abhisekh Tiwari sees Andre Russell sprint hard back for two runs towards fine leg.
19.3: Abhisekh Tiwari watches anxiously as Andre Russell scampers back for a brisk couple of runs to long-on.
19.4: Abhisekh Tiwari is launched over the ropes by Andre Russell for a colossal maximum toward deep mid-wicket.
19.5: Abhisekh Tiwari suffers again as Andre Russell dispatches another monstrous blow soaring over deep mid-wicket for six.
19.6: Abhisekh Tiwari runs in to bowl the final delivery to Andre Russell, who guides it cleanly toward point to pick up a single.
9.4: Aprajit Poudel drifts it through, and Bishal Shusling works it into the deep mid-wicket region to hustle back for a comfortable couple.
9.5: Dot ball from Aprajit Poudel to Bishal Shusling.
9.6: No run for Bishal Shusling off Aprajit Poudel.
10.1: Basir Ahamad slides one in, Saif Hassan guides it cleanly toward sweeper cover and trots through for a single.
10.2: Basir Ahamad keeps the pressure on, Bishal Shusling opening the face to steer it towards sweeper cover for one.
10.3: Basir Ahamad attacks the stumps, Saif Hassan glancing it fine down to third man to collect a sharp brace.
10.4: Basir Ahamad offers a hint of width, Saif Hassan punching it promptly into the sweeper cover area for a single.
10.5: Bishal Shusling does not score off Basir Ahamad.
10.6: Basir Ahamad bowls it full, Bishal Shusling driving firmly into the deep extra cover pocket to scamper back for two.
11.1: Aprajit Poudel loops it up, Saif Hassan stroking it smoothly out to deep extra cover to rotate the strike.
11.2: Aprajit Poudel pitches it in his arc, and Bishal Shusling launches it towering over deep mid-wicket all the way for a maximum.
11.3: Dot ball from Aprajit Poudel to Bishal Shusling.
11.4: Aprajit Poudel fires it flat, Bishal Shusling working it down to long-on to comfortably cross for a single.
11.5: Aprajit Poudel misses his length slightly, Saif Hassan punishing it with a massive heave over long-on for six runs.
11.6: Aprajit Poudel tosses it up one final time in the over, Saif Hassan driving it down to long-off for a single.
12.1: Dot ball from Basir Ahamad to Saif Hassan.
12.2: Basir Ahamad lands it on a length, Saif Hassan nudging it into the mid-wicket gap to pick up a single.
12.3: Basir Ahamad slides it through, nudged by Bishal Shusling down to long-on for a brisk single.
12.4: Basir Ahamad fires it in, pushed away expertly by Saif Hassan towards sweeper cover to rotate the strike.
